page_title: INT 2-0 LEC | Inter v Lecce 24/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+6' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
90+5' Kristjan Asllani (Inter) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Inter.
90+4' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) sends a long ball in, but Yann Sommer comfortably gathers the ball.
90+4' Medon Berisha (Lecce) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
90+3' Tete Morente (Lecce) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
90+3' Tete Morente (Lecce) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger. Now Lecce have a corner.

90+2' A neat pass finds Medon Berisha (Lecce) in space. He needs no second invitation to shoot and hits a piledriver from distance towards the bottom left corner, but Yann Sommer denies him with a good save. Lecce have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
90+1' The free kick is delivered by Medon Berisha (Lecce) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Poor challenge! Carlos Augusto (Inter) is penalised for tripping and Davide Di Marco blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Lecce.

88' Patrick Dorgu (Lecce) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the roof of the net is blocked by Yann Sommer, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net.
86' Substitution. Nikola Krstovic makes his way off the pitch and Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) comes on as his replacement.
85' Here is a change. Santiago Pierotti is going off and Luca Gotti gives the last tactical orders to Medon Berisha (Lecce).
84' Marko Arnautovic (Inter) almost finds himself in a very promising position, but he is flagged offside by the linesman.
82' Hakan Calhanoglu comes off the pitch to be replaced by Kristjan Asllani (Inter).
81' Benjamin Pavard (Inter) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
78' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Inter was in an offside position.
77' Marko Arnautovic (Inter) makes a terrific run to get on the end of the free kick and powers a header just over the bar from close in.
76' Substitution. Marcus Thuram is replaced by Marko Arnautovic (Inter).
76' One of the Lecce players commits a holding foul and the referee reaches for his whistle. Inter have a free kick.
74' It could have been a good chance to score! Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) fails to release Santiago Pierotti with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears.
72' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Nicolo Barella as he is replaced by Davide Frattesi (Inter).
72' Substitution. Denzel Dumfries (Inter) on for Matteo Darmian.
72' Simone Inzaghi decides to make a substitution. Federico Dimarco will be replaced by Carlos Augusto (Inter).
71' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
69' 2 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Wladimiro Falcone no chance!
69' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
68' Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce) is penalised for holding. Davide Di Marco signals a set piece. No point in arguing there. Inter will take a penalty kick.
67' Yann Sommer makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded by Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) after a cross from the side.
67' The corner from Balthazar Pierret (Lecce) is cleared away by the defence.
66' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) wriggles into space and fires the ball from the edge of the area, but one of the defenders is there to block the effort. Lecce will take a corner kick.
64' Luca Gotti has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tete Morente (Lecce) replacing Lameck Banda.
64' The referee allows time for a substitution. Hamza Rafia will be replaced by Santiago Pierotti (Lecce).
63' Federico Dimarco (Inter) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
60' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Lameck Banda (Lecce).
55' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
54' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.

53' Well-positioned Marcus Thuram (Inter) was first to the rebound and fired in a shot towards the right post, but Wladimiro Falcone reacted superbly to keep the ball out. The fans could not believe their eyes. It was a miraculous stop!
50' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
50' Federico Dimarco (Inter) has a shot blocked from inside the box. The ball goes out of play. Inter are awarded a corner kick.
49' Marcus Thuram (Inter) latches onto a long ball into the box and unleashes a fine volley at goal, but flashes the effort just wide of the left post. That would have been a great goal!
47' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
47' Federico Dimarco (Inter) works the corner short.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' Balthazar Pierret (Lecce) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
45+2' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Hamza Rafia (Lecce) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Lecce force a corner. They send men into the box.
45+1' Federico Dimarco (Inter) watches the ball all the way and connects well with a volley on the edge of the box, but sends the effort miles over the bar.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
42' Lameck Banda (Lecce) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Yann Sommer intercepts the ball.
38' Inter failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
38' Mehdi Taremi (Inter) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted. It will be a corner kick for Inter.
37' 4:1 – the total goal attempt statistics. Shots on target – 3:0.
32' A corner kick by Inter is thwarted by the well prepared Wladimiro Falcone (Lecce).

32' Federico Dimarco (Inter) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
31' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
30' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) sends the corner into the box, but Wladimiro Falcone intercepts it and averts the threat.
26' A cooling break is underway.
23' Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

23' Matteo Darmian (Inter) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball goes out for a corner. Inter can continue in their attacking effort.
21' Nikola Krstovic (Lecce) controls a great pass from Patrick Dorgu on the edge of the box, steadies himself but his poor effort goes yards over the bar.
19' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) sends a cross into the box, but Yann Sommer comes off his line to gather the ball.
19' Balthazar Pierret (Lecce) swings in a cross from the corner, but Yann Sommer reads it well and gathers the ball.
17' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Hakan Calhanoglu (Inter).
16' The Lecce players can’t believe it after referee Davide Di Marco signals NO PENALTY after the VAR review. Play to continue.
16' There's a break in play and referee Davide Di Marco must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Lecce using VAR. This could be interesting!
15' Surely that's handball by one of the Inter players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
14' Federico Dimarco (Inter) serves up a nice cross, but Wladimiro Falcone punches the ball away.
10' Matteo Darmian (Inter) sends a long ball forward to Marcus Thuram, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
8' Mehdi Taremi (Inter) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
7' Lameck Banda (Lecce) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
5' 1 - 0 GOAL! Matteo Darmian (Inter) scores with a header from close range after Mehdi Taremi headed a pin-point lofted cross into his path. It's 1:0.
4' Nicolo Barella (Inter) jumps into a tackle and Davide Di Marco signals a foul.
2' Alessandro Bastoni (Inter) picks out Matteo Darmian with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Lecce will have the kick-off.
Davide Di Marco got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
